mathematical_authority.parallel_complement_relation: For two coincident analytic parallels, the source overlap orientation determines whether the mapped parameters must satisfy v=u or v=1-u. The fixture exercises v=1-u across independent selected source parameters and a distinct positive homogeneous gauge.
mathematical_authority.two_radical_zero_test: After exact rational reduction, the unresolved identity has the form A+B/sqrt(S)+C/sqrt(T), with S,T strictly positive. Zero, one, and two nonzero-term cases are decided directly; the two-term case additionally requires opposite signs before comparing squares.
mathematical_authority.three_term_branch_proof: For three nonzero terms, the unique term whose sign differs from the other two is isolated. With positive magnitudes L,M,N, D=L^2-M^2-N^2 must be strictly positive and D^2=4*M^2*N^2. The sign prerequisite rejects the extraneous conjugate admitted by squaring.
mathematical_authority.stored_axis_fact: BezierAlgebraicChord2 stores certified_axis_aligned only after the analytic-pair-only complement proof succeeds under STRICT. APPROXIMATE_512 equality cannot create this persistent construction fact.
mathematical_authority.fragment_range: A complementary fragment computes the exact relation once and reuses end=1-start for range validation instead of comparing a differently gauged unary map independently to 512 bits.
mathematical_authority.persistent_representation: The selected-circle fragment, derived endpoints, and chord remain shared one-word handles; source polynomials are borrowed with Cow in the same-orientation path and common denominators avoid redundant cross-products.

benchmark_method.wall: Nine fresh processes pinned to CPU 11 per mode, 64 timed operations after one warm-up and one preflight. End-to-end reconstructs the cap; prebuilt isolates offset and regularization.
benchmark_method.perf: One pinned perf-stat process per artifact and matched disabled control, 64 timed operations plus one warm-up and one preflight. Subtract the corresponding disabled process and divide by 66.
benchmark_method.heap: Heaptrack record-only with eight timed operations, one warm-up, and one preflight. Subtract the matched disabled process and divide by ten. Valgrind Massif supplies the exact one-operation peak increment.
benchmark_method.size: Identically configured all-feature and no-default release test executables; actual .text comes from size -A and allocated totals from size.
benchmark_method.historical_caveat: The matched historical result is rejection latency, not a correctness-equivalent completed operation.
benchmark_method.competitive_caveat: Cavalier Contours 0.7.0 receives binary64 bulge geometry and supplies no exact selected fields, Hyper policy outcome, retained certificate, or guarantee-equivalent regularization. It is throughput context only.

wall_performance.interpretation: The one-time strict axis proof makes construction 24.72% slower, but retaining that fact makes repeated exact offset/regularization 3.92% faster and the complete operation 1.88% faster. Historical rejects and Cavalier is not guarantee-equivalent.

deterministic_perf.interpretation: The retained axis fact removes 3.58% of instructions, 4.50% of cycles, 3.65% of branches, and 6.68% of branch misses from the repeated prebuilt exact operation. End to end remains 1.78% lower in instructions and 2.35% lower in cycles after paying the construction proof.

allocation_evidence.interpretation: Repeated exact work makes 3.63% fewer allocation calls and 2.75% fewer recorder temporaries; its exact incremental peak is 9,488 bytes lower. The more expensive one-time proof remains visible in construction counts.

linked_size.interpretation: The completed all-feature predicate path adds 26,864 actual text bytes over historical rejection; the stored-axis optimization itself adds only 576 bytes. Dead stripping leaves the no-default executable 368 text bytes smaller than the matched historical artifact.
